update_text: When applying the Dividend Discount Model, verify that r > g (required return exceeds growth rate) before computing; if r ≤ g, the model is invalid and no finite price exists.
rationale: The DDM formula P_0 = D_1/(r-g) produces a negative or undefined result when r ≤ g, so this domain-specific guard prevents nonsensical outputs in dividend/growth scenarios.
